description.en: Harvard University in Cambridge, Massachusetts, is the oldest US university (1636). It is a private Ivy League research university with a broad liberal-arts undergraduate college and renowned graduate schools.

description.uz: Kembrijdagi (Massachusets) Harvard universiteti — AQShdagi eng qadimiy universitet (1636). Ayvi Ligasiga kiruvchi xususiy tadqiqot universiteti: keng qamrovli liberal sanʼat bakalavriati va mashhur magistratura maktablari.
